Name: Fish Weather Event - Rare Night Event All Fish
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]🎣Fish Weather: All Fish Night🐟
[/size][/b][color=#00ff00]
[/color][size=3][color=#00ff00]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[/color]
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=downloads]

[/url][/size]Fish Weather: All Fish Night is a rare nightly event mod that turns an ordinary day into something strange and exciting.

Some nights, the world feels different. The air is damp. The ground seems… alive. And then you notice it: fish are out there, flopping and gliding across the land as if the whole valley has become their ocean.

When the event happens, you’ll get a Fishing skill boost for the night and (optionally) a special rule change that makes fishing feel completely different: every body of water becomes a jackpot.

[b][color=#00ff00]What this mod does

[/color][/b][list]
[*][b]A rare “Fish Weather” can happen each day [/b](default: 5% chance).
[/list][list]
[*]If it triggers, it [b]activates during a time window you choose[/b] (default: 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM).
[/list][list]
[*]During the event window, you gain a [b]Fishing skill bonus[/b] (default: +2) that lasts until the event ends.
[/list][list]
[*]Fish appear as [b]moving land-swimmers across the whole map[/b], not clumped around you. They’re spread out so the world looks like it’s genuinely been “taken over” for the night.
[/list][list]
[*]Optional setting: [b]Catch any fish anywhere[/b] during the event. Every fishing spot becomes a chance at something unexpected — not restricted by season, weather, or location.
[/list][color=#00ff00][b]Why you’ll want it
[/b][/color]
This mod is built for players who love surprise, variety, and those “what just happened?” Stardew moments.

It adds a little mystery to your routine, a reason to stay out late, and a fun “special night” feeling without permanently changing your save. On some days nothing

changes — and on others, the valley becomes a fishing fantasy.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40467/40467-1766355179-355585102.png[/img]

[b][color=#00ff00]Customizable options
[/color][/b]
You can change everything in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu:

[list]
[*]Daily chance for the event to happen
[*]Start and end time
[*]Fishing bonus amount
[*]Whether to show a popup message when it begins
[*]Whether “catch any fish anywhere” is enabled
[*]How many land fish appear, and whether they can appear indoors
[/list][b][color=#00ff00]Multiplayer support
[/color][/b]
In co-op, the host decides whether the event happens that day, and everyone experiences the same Fish Weather together.

[b][color=#00ff00]Compatibility

[/color][/b][list]
[*]Works on Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]Should display fish added by other mods too
[/list]If you want your late nights to feel special and your fishing to occasionally turn into a full-blown event, Fish Weather: All Fish Day is made for your mod list.
